confidence_notes: June and current city data support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Lugano) Cocktail and wine estimates use local prices relative to beer, checked against a small sample of menus. [Tango drinks menu](https://tango-ti.ch/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/MENU-VINI-11-2023.pdf) [Al Barilotto wine menu](https://ristorante-al-barilotto.ch/la-cantina/) July lodging is modeled, with the greatest uncertainty for private hostel rooms and basic guesthouses.
comparable_city_reasoning: Locarno and the wider Ticino lake region provide a lodging benchmark because they share Swiss operating costs and strong summer tourism demand.
